title: Research: extend the P112 four-piece exclusion to ranks 3,5,6,6
body:
## Summary

The conditional P112 four-piece representation obstruction now permits a first piece of binary support rank three. The other bounds remain 5,6,6, with arbitrary coefficients, overlaps and cancellations over every characteristic-zero field.

```diff
- first-piece support-rank allowance: 2
+ first-piece support-rank allowance: 3
  remaining support ranks: 5,6,6
  premise: standard E8 Weyl-chamber theorem
```

The stronger theorem allows any first piece on at most four sites. The necessary three-large-section covers leave at least five sites, and a literal five-site coefficient witness attains that boundary. Its first-piece rank is five, so first-piece rank four remains open.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3397 established the 2,5,6,6 obstruction and supplied the kernel/affine methods. It is contextual pending work, not an inherited theorem here.
  **After:** the new proof and complete replay establish 3,5,6,6. All 3,309,747 binary five-spaces and 788,035 six-spaces are checked in each of three frame-preserving normal orbits. Separate affine enumeration matches every section set and exceptional-pair residual profile. The five-site witness has disjoint sizes 5,10,20,18 and exact binary ranks 5,5,6,6.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay, nine behavioral groups including four actual optimized CLI mutants, strict Ruff checks and formatting pass. The exact final publication head `370a2f5dd376f2c2686cf2ed3664aa30f59d6edc` passes committed-byte/source-history checks and an optimized, read-only Git-free export replay of all three commands. A metadata-only follow-up preserves all scientific proof, code, source and RESULT bytes.

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/p112-four-piece-rank3
```

Sources, exact receipts, proof, predecessor credit and open questions are in the isolated package. [Canonical investigation and initial scoped claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19009148). Credit Nick Petalas/PR3397, PR3405, PR3161/3162 and the retained root-simplex/E8/P112 lineage, including DreamingOfClouds and joaqcoo.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

Only a new research package is added. The standard Weyl-chamber theorem remains a mathematical premise; human and proof-kernel review are unrun. No actual caller, full C5, decoder floor, physical supplier, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed. Lean, Docker and the selected cold replay are unrun.
